general_regulations.title: PG General Regulations — M.Tech. & MCA
general_regulations.source_note: General regulations for M.Tech and MCA, as per the PG Regulations Reference Tables

last_attempt.label: Last Attempt
last_attempt.note: Last attempt is 4 years from the first semester of admission.

passing_minimum.label: CIE, SEE Passing Minimum
rows: 50% of maximum CIE marks (to be eligible to appear for SEE)
50% minimum overall; Minimum Passing Grade: C

gmr.label: GMR (Grace Marks Rule) — with effect from October 2024
gmr.rule: 2% of Maximum SEE marks — applicable on the condition that adding this to CIE and SEE will result in a Pass grade.

other_grades.meaning: Absent for the SEE of a registered Course
Shortage of attendance in a credit or non-credit course, with or without satisfying CIE requirements
Not satisfied the CIE requirements (non-credit course), with or without satisfying attendance
Pass grade in a non-credit course
Dropped or withdrawn from a registered course; re-registration required in summer semester to appear for SEE

class_declaration.label: Class Declaration
class_declaration.formula: Percentage of marks (P) = CGPA Earned × 10 (identical for both programs)
class_declaration.min_cgpa_for_degree: ≥ 5.00, with no course remaining at F grade (both programs)
